schema_notes: World Graph (C3) is polymorphed: in a sports title the 'graph' is the progression/ladder/map, NOT court traversal.
Ability System (C4) is polymorphed again, confirming player_controller/ability are polymorphic dialects (River City + Top Gun + Rad Racer pattern holds).
Boss (C7) maps cleanly: ladder-apex rival teams ARE bosses. Best 1:1 fit of any contract.

HYBRID IDENTITY FINDING: unlike Rad Racer (whole identity render-carried -> needs rendering_illusion_contract), this game SURVIVES greybox. Core is logic-carried; only the FLAIR (heat flames, gamebreaker cinematic, fight cam) is render-carried. This is a THIRD category your schema hasn't logged: 'render-carried seasoning' — a juice layer that is cosmetic, not load-bearing. It needs a rendering_juice_contract (optional FX bindings), NOT a rendering_illusion_contract (mandatory transform).
